backup.production_rule: Two live functions are replaced and one column default is added. Neither body was retyped: a script cut each from its applied migration, asserted the cut hashes to the live md5(prosrc) read on 2026-09-22 (run_system_verifier_v1 178b72de3f830cc7a2ab7acd0d7711bb, approve_opening_balances_v1 c63e53a873439c1b7a5a95f7c060f88f), then applied exact one-hit replacements. The forward checks assert the resulting bodies' md5, which is the only assertion that catches a mistyped copy. No table, row or policy is altered. The backup is taken as the LAST act before the apply (D-210): it aged out four times in session 42.

forward_verification.name: the_checks_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = '12b080bfff25b908f20bf4ae3813af9e' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'run_system_verifier_v1'

forward_verification.name: the_opening_balance_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = '8a9221b81874dbc3d52f51942f10c39b' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'approve_opening_balances_v1'

forward_verification.name: each_check_has_a_problem_phrase
forward_verification.query: select public.health_check_problem_v1('checkouts_cleaned') = 'Checkout with no cleaning logged' and public.health_check_problem_v1('inventory_ledger_consistent') = 'Inventory count disagrees with its movements'

forward_verification.name: no_v10_finding_is_titled_with_its_passing_label
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from jsonb_array_elements(public.run_system_verifier_v1('6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd', 'daily')->'found') e join public.admin_health_check_runs h on h.property_id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd' and 'V10:' || h.check_key = e->>'key' where e->>'title' = h.label

forward_verification.name: at_least_one_live_v10_finding_exists_to_prove_the_title_check
forward_verification.query: select count(*) > 0 from jsonb_array_elements(public.run_system_verifier_v1('6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd', 'daily')->'found') e where e->>'check_id' = 'V10' and e->>'key' <> 'V10:stale'

forward_verification.name: v10_detail_no_longer_moves_on_every_refresh
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from jsonb_array_elements(public.run_system_verifier_v1('6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd', 'daily')->'found') e where e->>'check_id' = 'V10' and e->'detail' ? 'ran_at'

forward_verification.name: a_stale_health_run_is_red
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(e->>'severity' = 'red') from jsonb_array_elements(public.run_system_verifier_v1('6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd', 'daily', now() + interval '3 days')->'found') e where e->>'key' = 'V10:stale'

forward_verification.name: seeded_heartbeats_are_born_alive
forward_verification.query: select column_default = 'now()' from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'job_heartbeats' and column_name = 'last_succeeded_at'

forward_verification.name: grants_are_what_they_were
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.run_system_verifier_v1(uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.approve_opening_balances_v1(uuid, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.approve_opening_balances_v1(uuid, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.health_check_problem_v1(text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.health_check_problem_v1(text)', 'EXECUTE')

forward_verification.name: the_hourly_scope_still_says_nothing_about_v10
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from jsonb_array_elements(public.run_system_verifier_v1('6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd', 'hourly')->'found') e where e->>'check_id' = 'V10'

rollback.safe_until: always. Nothing new depends on health_check_problem_v1 except run_system_verifier_v1, which the rollback restores first.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20260923_verifier_triage_and_opening_amounts.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh. It restores both functions to their pre-release bodies (hash-checked at build time), drops the heartbeat default, then drops health_check_problem_v1. Stored finding titles stay problem phrases until the next daily run.

feature_flags.name: first_daily_run_reopens_acknowledged_v10_once
feature_flags.required_state: detail loses ran_at and gains label, so the first daily run after the apply sees a changed detail and reopens any acknowledged V10 finding one last time. Acknowledge them from that card; from then on an acknowledgement holds until the count or rows change.

compatibility.evidence: system-verifier v3 (deployed 2026-09-22 22:44Z) renders V10 cards from problemSubject(check key), not from title, and its promoted() already makes these two cases red at card time, so the stored severity and title change nothing the card says; they change the reminder cadence (24 h for red) and what the table holds. apply_verifier_run_v1 is untouched. approve_opening_balances_v1 gains one refusal, before any write, for a line the dashboard never sends (setup-page.tsx always sends both keys, '' for the unused side; the one live batch has that shape). pgTAP verifier_triage_and_opening_amounts.sql, 22 assertions, one fires/silent pair per rule; health_checks_core_v10.sql line 154 inverted to isnt(label).

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
either md5 check fails - that is a mistyped body, not a flaky assertion
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty
the rehearsal has not run the two pgTAP suites green on this commit
